news.title:
Senco Gold declines 4%; Motilal Oswal retains 'Neutral' rating.
Key details include Q4 performance and FY27 guidance insights.

Senco Gold fell 5.3% to Rs 330.80 despite Q4 FY26 profit surging 151% YoY to Rs 157 crore.
Revenue grew 45% YoY in Q4; margins improved but QoQ profits dropped 40.5% amid weak volumes and inventory concerns.
SENCO: Dividend Plans And Q4 Results Will Shape Fairly Valued Shares
news.body: Analysts have lifted Senco Gold's fair value estimate from ₹325 to ₹355, citing updated assumptions around discount rates, revenue growth, profit margins, and future P/E that together support a higher price target. What's in the News Senco Gold has scheduled a board meeting for May 26, 2026, to consider and approve audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the fourth quarter and full year ended March 31, 2026.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹35.08 (up from ₹10.09 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹85.1b (up 35% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹5.74b (up 261% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 6.7% (up from 2.5% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 2.3%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 22%. Revenue is forecast to grow 13% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 16% growth forecast for the Specialty Retail industry in India.

news.title: Senco Gold Limited Recommends Final Dividend  for the Financial Year 2025-26
news.body:
Senco Gold Limited announced that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on May 26,2026, have inter alia: Recommended a Final Dividend at the rate of 20 % (INR 1 per equity share) of the face value
of equity shares of INR  5 each, for the Financial Year 2025-26. The Final Dividend, if approved by the shareholders at the forthcoming Annual General Meeting (AGM) of the Company, shall be paid to the shareholders on or before 30 days from the date of AGM.

news.title: New major risk - Revenue and earnings growth
news.body: Earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 5.9% per year for the foreseeable future. This is considered a major risk. Ultimately, shareholders want to see a good return on their investment and that generally comes from sharing in the company's profits. If profits are expected to decline, then in most cases the share price will decline over time as well. In addition, if the company pays dividends it will also likely need to reduce or cut them, striking a dual blow to total shareholder returns. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Debt is not well covered by operating cash flow (currently running at an operating cash loss). Earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 5.9% per year for the foreseeable future.

news.title: Senco Gold Limited (NSEI:SENCO) agreed to acquire an unknown stake in August Jewellery Private Limited.
news.body:
Senco Gold Limited (NSEI:SENCO) agreed to acquire an unknown stake in August Jewellery Private Limited on January 21, 2026. A cash consideration will be paid by Senco Gold Limited. Senco Gold Limited is proposing to acquire 68% of the August Jewellery Private Limited’s equity share capital for an amount aggregating to INR 680 million. In this regard, Senco Gold Limited will execute: (a) Share Subscription Agreement, (b) Shareholders’ Agreement and any other related documents, as may be required during the course of the transaction with August Jewellery Private Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, August Jewellery Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 332.49 million.
